# Technical Debt Template — GULA Platform

## Item: D-NNN: [Debt Title]

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Description** | What the debt is |
| **Location** | File or module reference |
| **Category** | Testing / Type Safety / Coverage / Dependencies / Architecture / Configuration / Documentation |
| **Severity** | 1 (Cosmetic) — 5 (Critical) |
| **Frequency** | 1 (Rare) — 5 (Always) |
| **Score** | Severity × Frequency |
| **Score Level** | 1-3 Low / 4-6 Medium / 7-9 High / 10+ Critical |
| **Impact** | What problems it causes |
| **Fix** | How to resolve |
| **Effort** | Estimated person-days |
| **Priority** | Critical / High / Medium / Low / Backlog |
| **Status** | Open / In Progress / Resolved / Won't Fix |

## Details

Extended description of the debt, including:
- When it was introduced
- Why it exists (intentional or accidental)
- What modules/files are affected
- Any blockers to fixing it

## Resolution Plan

| Step | Action | Est. Effort |
|------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | Step one | X days |
| 2 | Step two | X days |
| 3 | Step three | X days |

## Dependencies

- Item one (blocked by / blocks)
- Item two

## Notes

Additional context or cross-references to risk register items.
